description: This file defines a wrapper interface for GLib functions, including an abstract implementation class (GLibWrapsImpl) and a singleton-like access class (GLibWraps). It declares methods for checking if a main loop is running, connecting signals, and disconnecting signal handlers, along with external C linkage functions.

classes.name: GLibWrapsImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface class defining virtual methods for GLib operations related to main loop status and signal handling.

classes.name: GLibWraps
classes.description: Wrapper class providing static methods to interact with GLib functions, using an implementation provided by GLibWrapsImpl.

methods.name: GLibWraps::setImpl
methods.description: Sets the internal implementation instance used by the GLibWraps singleton.

methods.name: GLibWraps::getInstance
methods.description: Returns a reference to the singleton instance of GLibWraps.

methods.name: GLibWraps::g_main_loop_is_running
methods.description: Checks if a given GMainLoop is currently running.

methods.name: GLibWraps::g_signal_connect_data
methods.description: Connects a signal handler function to a signal for a GObject instance.

methods.name: GLibWraps::signal_handlers_disconnect_by_data
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers associated with a specific data pointer.

methods.name: GLibWraps::signal_handlers_disconnect_by_func
methods.description: Disconnects signal handlers associated with a specific callback function.
